# SiriusXM Delivers the Soundtrack to the Holidays with Its Festive Lineup of 25 Handcrafted Seasonal Music Channels


October 28, 2026 10:40am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_c6dea7d97887316142c3aabf4b411af3/siriusxm/news/2026-10-28_SiriusXM_Delivers_the_Soundtrack_to_the_Holidays_2313.pdf)


***Lineup features channels produced and presented by celebrated personalities and iconic brands, including Jimmy Fallon, Hallmark, Trans-Siberian Orchestra and more.***


******


**NEW YORK – October 28, 2026 –** SiriusXM is making spirits bright with the return of its beloved holiday music lineup, bringing the sounds of the season to listeners with 25 handcrafted festive channels. From traditional holiday staples to seasonal hits, this year’s lineup has something for everyone, including Hallmark Radio, Trans-Siberian Orchestra Radio, Mannheim Steamroller Channel and more. The most wonderful time of the year starts Monday, November 2 on SiriusXM, with many channels launching in-car and streaming on the SiriusXM app.


SiriusXM’s highly anticipated holiday lineup brings nonstop cheer to listeners with a merry mix of festive music curated by fan-favorite personalities and brands that bring the magic of the season to life. From timeless holiday classics and traditional Christmas carols to Radio Hanukkah and genre-specific channels featuring holiday pop, country Christmas, seasonal soul and more, SiriusXM has the perfect hand-picked soundtrack for every holiday moment.


SiriusXM is inviting listeners to become part of the holiday magic. By visiting[https://www.siriusxm.com/seasonsgreetings](https://www.siriusxm.com/seasonsgreetings) , fans can record a voice or video message to share their favorite holiday memories, request seasonal songs, or send festive shout-outs for a chance to be featured on their favorite holiday channels.


SiriusXM’s holiday channels are available to subscribers in their cars and on the SiriusXM app. Eligible customers can get their first three months of SiriusXM for free. Click[here](https://siriusxm.com/Get3mosFree) to sign up and experience all that SiriusXM has to offer. See Offer Details.


For more information, visit[https://www.siriusxm.com/music/holidays](https://www.siriusxm.com/music/holidays) .


**SiriusXM’s Holiday Channel Line-Up**


**70s/80s Holiday:** The biggest holiday hits of the 70s and 80s featuring songs from The Carpenters and The Jackson 5 to Wham! and Bruce Springsteen. Bringing back the sounds, memories, and magic of the season. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Acoustic Christmas:** Unplug from seasonal stress with a warm blend of acoustic holiday tunes. Relax to Christmas-themed songs from artists including Taylor Swift, Phoebe Bridgers, Kacey Musgraves and The Lumineers, alongside a diverse array of emerging singer-songwriters.


Available on the SiriusXM app from November 2 through December 27 and on channel 17 December 24 through December 25. ****


**Christmas Spirit:** Christmas music and family holiday favorites from contemporary Christian artists heard on SiriusXM’s The Message. Here the reason for the season is not just remembered, He is celebrated in song! Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through January 6 and on channel 79 from December 2 through December 27.


**Cool Jazz Christmas:** A smooth and jazzy holiday soundtrack that is everything you need for a cool yule. Pour the eggnog and let the good vibes flow with Christmas classics from some of the greatest contemporary and smooth jazz instrumentalists including Dave Koz, David Benoit, Kenny G and Boney James, with a sprinkling of festive vocal magic from the likes of Diana Krall, Laufey and Anita Baker. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Country Christmas:** Country stars spanning many generations come together with both traditional and contemporary holiday songs. Hear music from artists including George Strait, Carrie Underwood, Willie Nelson, Lainey Wilson and more. Available on the SiriusXM app


November 2 through December 27 and on channel 58 from December 2 through December 27.


**Hallmark Radio:** Hallmark Radio is back for the holidays featuring timeless Christmas music and carols that celebrate the joy of the season. Hear the songs you love including new music from this year's Hallmark original movies and series. Available on the SiriusXM app and channel 300 from November 2 through December 27. Leave a holiday message on the Joy Line at[https://www.siriusxm.com/joyline](https://www.siriusxm.com/joyline) for a chance to be featured on the channel.


**Holiday Chill-Out:** Back by popular demand, SiriusXM welcomes back Holiday Chill-Out featuring downtempo electronic and house music as the perfectly chilled channel to wrap and open gifts or just relax by the chilled-out fire with your family this holiday season. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Holiday Instrumentals:** Instrumental versions of seasonal favorites designed to set the holiday mood. No vocals, just holiday melodies you can sing along with. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Holiday Pops:** Celebrate the season with timeless Christmas carols and holiday favorites, enjoy treasured works by Handel, Tchaikovsky and John Rutter, alongside performances by King’s College Choir, the Boston Pops, the Tabernacle Choir and more. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27 and on channel 66 from December 24 through December 25.


**Holiday Traditions:** Traditional holiday favorites by treasured artists that span the decades, along with some instrumental versions perfect for singing along. Available on the SiriusXM app year-round and on channel 71 from November 2 through December 27.


**Holly:** Merry and bright holiday hits featuring songs by Mariah Carey, Michael Bublé, Dean Martin, Kelly Clarkson, Pentatonix, Josh Groban, John Legend, Brenda Lee, Train, Gwen Stefani and more. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through January 6 and on channel 144 from November 2 through December 27.


**Jimmy Fallon's Holiday Seasoning Radio:** Jimmy Fallon spreads holiday cheer with his favorite festive songs, hilarious stories, heartfelt fan dedications, and appearances from his famous friends. Hear a joyful mix of timeless classics, modern hits, and a few surprises, all delivered with Jimmy’s signature humor. The channel spans every era and genre, including music from Jimmy’s Christmas album, Holiday Seasoning, plus artists like Paul McCartney, Taylor Swift, Bing Crosby, the Jonas Brothers, Nat King Cole, Ariana Grande, Mariah Carey, Michael Bublé, Frank Sinatra, Dolly Parton, and so many more. Available on the SiriusXM app and on channel 14 from November 2 through December 27. Leave a joyful message for Jimmy on the Holiday Hotline at[https://www.siriusxm.com/holidayhotline](https://www.siriusxm.com/holidayhotline) for a chance to be featured on the channel.


**Jingle Jamz:** Jingle Jamz features a mix of R&B and Hip-Hop artists from the 90’s to now, singing and rapping about the holidays. ‘Tis the season to be jammin’ with artists like Boyz II Men, Snoop Dogg, Mary J. Blige, Mariah Carey, Outkast, John Legend and more. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Jolly Christmas:** Upbeat, energetic holiday hits from The Chipmunks and Gene Autry to Mariah Carey and Jose Feliciano. Feel-good singing along, bringing smiles to the season. Available on the SiriusXM app and channel 608 November 2 through December 27.


**Kids Christmas:** The soundtrack for the most magical time of year! Welcome the holiday season with songs the whole family will love. From holiday classics to today’s most jingle-jangling tunes, it’s all here on Kid’s Christmas. Rudolph, Santa Claus, and Frosty the Snowman take over the airwaves to delight both kids and kids-at-heart all season long. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Mannheim Steamroller Channel:** Celebrate the magic of the season with Mannheim Steamroller! Join founder Chip Davis for a musical journey through more than four decades of the group's iconic Christmas recordings and the groundbreaking *Fresh Aire* series. Experience their signature blend of symphonic, New Age and rock-inspired sounds that have captivated listeners for generations. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Navidad:** Celebrate the season with the rhythms and traditions of a Latin Christmas. From festive parrandas and tropical favorites to timeless holiday classics, enjoy music from Ricky Martin, Gloria Estefan, José Feliciano, Tito El Bambino, Marco Antonio Solís and more. Available on the SiriusXM app and channel 626 November 2 through January 6.


**New Year's Nation:** It's a non-stop party with New Year's Nation! Your ultimate upbeat multi-format mix featuring the year's biggest now to next hits to ring in the new year. Available on channel 144 from December 28 through January 1.


**Noël Incontournable:** Hear francophone Christmas classics and contemporary holiday hits from the 60s to today with music from Ginette Reno, Bruno Pelletier and Laurence Nerbonne. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Radio Hanukkah:** Extensive collection of Hanukkah-themed music, including contemporary, traditional and children’s selections as well as daily reflections and prayers related to the holiday. Available on the SiriusXM app December 2 through December 14.


**Real Jazz Holiday:** Bop and swing under the mistletoe with some of the most memorable Christmas classics that make for a “real” jazz holiday. Hear jazz masters like Ella Fitzgerald, Louis Armstrong and the Count Basie Orchestra to today’s stars like Wynton Marsalis, Samara Joy and Christian McBride. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Rockin' Xmas:** Get on Santa’s naughty list with Christmas songs that rock! Hear memorable holiday hits from AC/DC, Paul McCartney, Bon Jovi, U2, Tom Petty, Bruce Springsteen, Pearl Jam, Eagles, Blink-182 and more. Trim your tree and fill your stockings and ears with seasonal Classic Rock, Punk Rock, Hard Rock, Alternative Rock, Hair Metal and Blues Rock. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Sleep Christmas:** Drift off to meditative versions of classic Christmas melodies and stay well-rested throughout the holidays with Sleep Christmas. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.


**Smokey's Holiday Soul Town:** Celebrate the season with Smokey Robinson and soulful holiday favorites from the ’60s and ’70s! From Motown classics by The Miracles, The Supremes and The Jackson 5 to holiday soul from Otis Redding and Lou Rawls, it’s all in Smokey’s Holiday Soul Town. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27 and on channel 74 from December 2 through December 27.


**Trans-Siberian Orchestra Radio:** ‘Tis the season to rock with Trans-Siberian Orchestra! Dive into the realm where rock pushes classical boundaries, holiday classics fuse with powerful electric guitars and a diverse array of vocalists come together to create storytelling like no other. Hear the band's iconic Christmas discography, exclusive concert recordings, and much more. Available on the SiriusXM app November 2 through December 27.

**About Sirius XM Holdings Inc.**


SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, with a portfolio of audio businesses including its flagship subscription entertainment service SiriusXM; the ad-supported and premium music streaming services of Pandora; an expansive podcast network; and a complete ecosystem of advertising solutions through SiriusXM Media and AdsWizz. SiriusXM offers live, on-demand, and human-curated programming across music, talk, news, sports, and podcasts, and the company reaches approximately 255 million monthly listeners across its platforms. With deep automotive manufacturer relationships and unique spectrum assets, SiriusXM is built to reach listeners wherever they are. The company connects fans to the voices, creators, and moments they love - creating communities where listeners engage, participate, and belong. For more about SiriusXM, please go to:[https://www.siriusxm.com/](http://www.siriusxm.com/)
